materials.content: The notice reports that site A produced 30 units. Source: https://fixture.example/record-f

basis.quote: Measurement record: site B produced 30 units; site A produced 20 units.

raw_response.rationale: The eligible original measurement record gives site A's result as 20 units and assigns 30 units to site B. The notice misstates its cited source.
